meta.name: secrets-management
meta.description: Implement secure secrets management for CI/CD pipelines using Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or native platform solutions. Use when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

copy.tagline: 保护 CI/CD 流水线中的敏感凭据免遭泄露
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 CI/CD 中管理密钥却担心泄露风险
copy.tagline_en: Secure sensitive credentials in your CI/CD pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle secrets in CI/CD and worry about leaks

howto.what: 它会帮你把 API key、数据库密码、TLS 证书等敏感凭证存进 Vault、AWS Secrets Manager 或平台原生存储,并写出对应的 CI/CD 配置和轮换脚本,避免把密钥写死在代码里。
howto.when: 当你要处理敏感凭证、轮换密钥,或加固 CI/CD 环境时触发。

say.text: 帮我把数据库密码存进 Vault,并在 GitHub Actions 里读取。
say.note: 会给出 vault-action 的 YAML 片段

say.text: 检查我的 CI 配置有没有硬编码密钥,加上 TruffleHog 扫描。

howto.what_en: It moves sensitive credentials such as API keys, database passwords, and TLS certificates into Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or native stores, and writes the matching CI/CD configs and rotation scripts so secrets stay out of code.
howto.when_en: Use when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

say_en.text: Store my database password in Vault and read it in GitHub Actions.
Store the prod DB password in AWS Secrets Manager and add a rotation Lambda.
Scan my CI config for hardcoded secrets and add TruffleHog.
